## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -15.86%) BELOW TREND shows fear easing while HYG (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +0.83%) and LQD (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +0.38%) ABOVE TREND signal credit support — mixed signals with weak breadth justify CAUTION.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit signal mixed but supportive: HYG (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +0.38%) ABOVE TREND indicate easing credit stress, while VXX (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -15.86%) BELOW TREND confirms lower near-term fear.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tight: UUP proxy (Dollar) (1W: +0.79% | 1M: +0.04%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +0.50%) ABOVE TREND keep stocks vs bonds balanced with SPY/TLT flat, so conditions are not clearly stimulative.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Technology leading but narrow: XLK (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +5.67%) ABOVE TREND and Financials XLF (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +1.15%) ABOVE TREND show leadership, yet only 4/11 sectors positive — style: Growth tilt but narrow leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US still favored: SPY (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +3.73%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +0.42% | 1M: +4.81%) ABOVE TREND; Emerging markets EEM (1W: +0.03% | 1M: +5.58%) ABOVE TREND but China FXI (1W: -0.98% | 1M: -2.77%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative flows intact but bifurcated: IBIT (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +19.62%) ABOVE TREND and ETHA (1W: +0.71% | 1M: +26.60%) ABOVE TREND show appetite, while ARKK (1W: -1.88% | 1M: +16.04%) CORRECTION and IWM (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +1.08%) CORRECTION point to short-term profit-taking.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Agri and thematic reflation: WEAT (1W: +10.19% | 1M: +13.73%) ABOVE TREND and CORN (1W: +4.94% | 1M: +12.33%) ABOVE TREND; base metals mixed with CPER (1W: -0.80% | 1M: +0.84%) CORRECTION and Gold GLD (1W: -3.42% | 1M: +8.41%) CORRECTION.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy soft on the week: XLE (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +6.31%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +3.66%) CORRECTION, while natural gas UNG (1W: +3.40% | 1M: +3.20%) ABOVE TREND shows strength.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLK (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +5.67%) ABOVE TREND and SPY (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +3.73%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: ARKK (1W: -1.88% | 1M: +16.04%), GLD (1W: -3.42% | 1M: +8.41%), XLE (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +6.31%) — MAJOR Divergence across growth/commodities that mutes a pure risk-on read.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor selective growth exposure: XLK (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +5.67%) ABOVE TREND and IGV (1W: +5.93% | 1M: +17.35%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength, and reduce exposure to laggards/defensive weak spots such as XLRE (1W: -1.33% | 1M: -1.81%) BELOW TREND and XLU (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -4.32%) BELOW TREND given narrow breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Tech/Software via XLK (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +5.67%) ABOVE TREND and IGV (1W: +5.93% | 1M: +17.35%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy/Commodities on weekly weakness XLE (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +6.31%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +3.66%) CORRECTION.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Agri complex WEAT (1W: +10.19% | 1M: +13.73%) ABOVE TREND and CORN (1W: +4.94% | 1M: +12.33%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -3.42% | 1M: +8.41%) CORRECTION and Brent BNO (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +3.66%) CORRECTION if weekly selling continues.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 18.36 (complacency) with VXX (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -15.86%) BELOW TREND; Credit spread ~0.75 (HYG/LQD health) with HYG (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND; Tech vs Financials ~3.20 (Tech leadership) with XLK (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +5.67%) ABOVE TREND; Breadth 4/11 (narrow).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, VXX (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -15.86%) BELOW TREND and HYG (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND provide conflicting confirmations. XLK (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +5.67%) and select thematic ETFs (IGV (1W: +5.93% | 1M: +17.35%) ABOVE TREND) showing strength while ARKK (1W: -1.88% | 1M: +16.04%) and GLD (1W: -3.42% | 1M: +8.41%) divergences are the key risks to monitor.
